chapters.reason: The paper introduces Lightning Attention, a linear attention mechanism designed to reduce the quadratic complexity of standard transformers.

The paper discusses TransNormerLLM, which utilizes the proposed attention mechanism to create a more efficient architecture, aligning with the goal of converting transformer-like structures into more efficient linear forms.
The paper evaluates the proposed architecture on language modeling tasks, which is the foundational step for applying subquadratic attention to reasoning tasks.
